description: The most markable code there is — string parsing into a `Map` — is green: `Map`/`Set` membership and mutation, `Object.entries`, and the `String` methods that take an optional parameter all carry a clean color. `new Map()` is the control, and it is reported: every hazard the constructor has is about the iterable, ECMA-262 returns before all of it when the argument is absent, and an entry is a fact about the function rather than about the arity a call used.
